visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a three-panel split-screen video call interface. In the top panel, a young man with dark hair wears a vertical-striped beige shirt. In the bottom-left panel, a young woman wears an orange cap and sunglasses. In the bottom-right panel, a man in a pink floral shirt and red cap is talking. The background for each panel appears to be an indoor office or home setting with neutral lighting. (2) The man in the top panel suddenly freezes in a still pose with his hand raised, pretending the video connection has failed. The other two participants watch him closely; the woman in the bottom left points her finger and laughs while the man in the bottom right touches his throat. Floating question marks and exclamation points appear over the frozen panel. (3) The scene cuts to the man in the pink floral shirt sitting alone on a grey fabric couch in a living room. He holds a smartphone and looks at it with a shocked expression as the video call ends. He then stands up quickly and runs toward a white wall with a doorbell panel. (4) A close-up shows a hand pressing a digital doorbell. A dark brown door opens to reveal the man in the striped shirt. The man in the pink floral shirt pushes his way inside, wearing white-rimmed sunglasses now. They stand in a brightly lit hallway near a window. (5) The two men are now seen in various locations: standing in a bright living room, walking under a concrete bridge outdoors, and sitting together on a white couch. The man in the pink shirt holds a smartphone and a laptop with several colorful Hello Kitty and anime stickers on the lid. The man in the striped shirt looks at the laptop screen with an excited, wide-mouthed expression. (6) The final phase shows both men sitting on the couch posing for the camera. The man in the pink shirt gives a thumbs-up while the man in the striped shirt rests his chin on his hand. Sparkle graphics and a large brand logo overlay the scene.
